The mention that acts

An @teammate mention is a durable message, an inbox signal, and—when sent from a channel—a route toward the teammate’s current work.

02 Read the inks

The visual difference is a product difference, not decoration.

Solid ink · verified in the current UI or CLI Ghost ink · intended framing, not a current control
Current option surface
  • ✓Inbox row: open the notification target and mark the row read.The current click-through lands on the entity’s Discussion with the message highlighted.
  • ✓Thread: use Reply in thread from the opened channel message.A nested reply keeps its direct parent; thread context is not flattened.
  • ✓Channel @ picker, live: “Message live session · …”.The server stores the message before PTY delivery.
  • ✓Channel @ picker, not live: “Start a work session when sent”.The new session becomes a real message destination.
Proposed convergence

One inbox action fork

A single menu offering “reply / deliver / spawn” at the inbox row is not present in the current UI. This artifact does not render those as live inbox controls.

Why the sequence still has three reaches Reply, live delivery, and spawn are all real behaviors. They live on different surfaces and at different moments today; the centrepiece preserves that destination context.

03 Destination is part of the meaning

The text can be identical while the graph context changes what tm8 does with it.

# Channel

The conversation origin. The top-level message is stored here, and the typed mention produces the inbox signal.

↩ Thread parent

The reply relationship. A reply carries the exact parent message, so the answer stays with the question.

▣ Work session

A durable anchor and, while live, a delivery address. Storage succeeds independently of whether the PTY settles.

◹ Inbox

A notification view for what wants you. It points back to context; it is not itself a terminal transport.

04 The same law at the wire

The CLI makes storage-first delivery explicit. These are real current commands, not a second interface invented for the lesson.

session destinationmessages.post
tm8 message send --to <work-session-id> \
  --wait settled "Check the release blocker"
stored first · delivery attempted second
exit 11 means stored-but-unsettled, not failed persistence
fresh destinationexecution.spawn
tm8 session spawn --teammate <team-member-id> \
  --mode worker --context "Release-room mention"
work_session created · server-hosted PTY started
the message can then be sent to the returned session id
01

One public text action: tm8 message send creates a durable message per anchor and then attempts delivery. A live work session is addressed like any other anchor.

05 Keep this

@

A mention is stored communication first. Its inbox signal returns you to the conversation; its session reach is chosen from real liveness, and every reply keeps the message it answers.

solid paths verified in UI source and live CLI help
